definitions.explanation: rain leaking through a damaged roof into a building

examples.japanese: {雨漏|あまも}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、{雨漏|あまも}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: A roof leak was found after the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{雨漏|あまも}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Since it's an old house, the roof leak needs to be repaired.

notes:
{雨漏|あまも}り refers specifically to rain leaking through a roof.

ETYMOLOGY:
- {雨|あま} (rain) + {漏|も}り (leaking)
- Note: {雨|あま} uses the kun'yomi that appears in compounds

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {雨漏|あまも}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (there is a roof leak)
- {雨漏|あまも}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直|なお}す (to fix a roof leak)
- {雨漏|あまも}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to repair a roof leak)
- {雨漏|あまも}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧ (the leak is bad)

COMMON CAUSES:
- ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧ (typhoon)
- ⟦{老朽化|ろうきゅうか}→老朽化：07646_roukyuuka⟧ (aging, deterioration)
- ⟦{瓦|かわら}→瓦：03902_kawara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ずれ→ずれ：10044_zure⟧ (shifted roof tiles)
- {経年劣化|けいねんれっか} (wear and tear)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{水漏|みずも}れ→水漏れ：07936_mizumore⟧ (water leak - general)
- ⟦{漏|も}れる→漏れる：02435_moreru⟧ (to leak - verb)
- ⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧ (roof)
- ⟦{修繕|しゅうぜん}→修繕：06569_shuuzen⟧ (repair)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {雨漏|あまも}り: Specifically rain through roof
- ⟦{水漏|みずも}れ→水漏れ：07936_mizumore⟧: General water leak (pipes, etc.)

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Common problem in Japan due to:
  - Heavy rainy season (⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧)
  - Typhoons
  - Traditional wood and tile construction
- Regular roof maintenance is important

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in everyday conversation.
